name: Extension Activity Tracker
description: Tracks assistant actions across extensions to verify sentinel persistence. Should see actions from ALL extensions as one continuous codon.
userPromptText:
You are tracking assistant activity for a codon that may extend multiple times. Count the number of assistant actions in this batch and note any patterns.

Actions received (<%- it.events.length %> total):
<% it.events.forEach(function(event, i) { %>
<%- i+1 %>. <%- event.data.content ? event.data.content.substring(0, 100) : '(no content)' %>
<% }); %>

Respond with a single line: 'Batch processed: X actions from codon activity'
